title: Asana Starter to self-hosted Plane
summary: Plane is the modern-looking one — cycles, modules, and an issue UI your team already knows how to use.

you_lose: Asana's maturity — Plane is three years old and its API still moves
Workload view and time tracking at Asana's depth
you_gain: A UI so close to Linear/Asana that the training cost is an afternoon
AGPL-3.0, unlimited members, no seat pricing
Cycles and modules that map cleanly onto sprint-style work

caveats: Plane moves fast, which cuts both ways — pin your Docker image tags and read the changelog before updating.
There is no Asana importer. The 10-hour estimate covers CSV export from Asana and hand-rebuilding projects and panels.
